title: Do not write git for retrieve telemetry
trigger: when updating activation_count after a retrieve
behavior_delta: Do not rewrite git atoms to bump activation_count. Increment SQLite only and preserve counts across reindex.
what: Retrieve used to dirty git diffs with hit counters. Shared history is admitted content, not telemetry.
why: Git noise and extra IO on every successful retrieve. Local telemetry belongs in the index.

retrieval_forms.micro: Do not bump activation_count in git.
retrieval_forms.short: Retrieve telemetry lives in SQLite. Do not rewrite git atoms for hit counters.
